_about: The dealer embed's texts (ADR-150, docs/plans/dealer-embed.md): the configurator on a dealer's website, our hosted checkout and status page in the dealer's look, the confirm page and the mails. One entry per text, one value per language (nl, en, de, fr). A dealer's own title, intro, button and thank-you text (Shop → Dealer embeds) win over these. {dealer} is the dealer's name, {n} a number. Draft texts: the owner checks them here.

intro.nl: Kies je meubel, geef de maten en zie direct de prijs. Op maat gemaakt van 100 % acryl.
intro.en: Choose your furniture, give its sizes and see the price at once. Made to measure in 100 % acrylic.
intro.de: Wählen Sie Ihr Möbel, geben Sie die Maße ein und sehen Sie sofort den Preis. Maßgefertigt aus 100 % Acryl.
intro.fr: Choisissez votre meuble, indiquez ses dimensions et voyez le prix tout de suite. Sur mesure, en 100 % acrylique.

choose_kind.en: What would you like to cover?

sizes_help.nl: Meet het meubel zelf, op het breedste punt, in centimeters.
sizes_help.en: Measure the furniture itself, at its widest point, in centimetres.

sizes_help.fr: Mesurez le meuble lui-même, à son point le plus large, en centimètres.
